finalists.label: Brainstem Encephalitis
finalists.why: It has specific findings such as bilateral horizontal gaze palsy with impaired oculocephalic reflexes, bulbar dysarthria, and quadriplegia with bilateral extensor plantar responses that are not shared with its rivals.

finalists.label: Encephalitis
finalists.why: It has general findings such as fever, vomiting, and weakness in all four limbs that are consistent with the vignette, and it has no findings against it.

frontier_selector.why: The champion is chosen because it accounts for the most decisive findings in the vignette, such as bilateral horizontal gaze palsy and quadriplegia, which are specific to brainstem involvement.
